Union Minister J.P. Nadda on Sunday criticised Rahul Gandhi over the INDIA bloc’s November 1 rally at Delhi’s Ramlila Maidan, accusing the Opposition of attempting to create political anarchy. The rally was organised to protest against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar and the Election Commission’s Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls, which Opposition parties have questioned.
